pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with sharp pixel-level gradients at edges. Spatial area is variable, with larger, more complex shapes on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more uniform shapes on the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological web. Junction nodes typically consist of 3-way or 4-way intersections. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, widening at intersections and thinning along lateral boundaries.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal neck line. Individual bristle clusters are visible as small, jagged vertical extensions against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural break or reduction in mane density is visible at the base of the neck where it transitions to the shoulder ridge.
